title: Matam Ghame shabbir Me Aelaane wafa Hai
body:
Matam Ghame shabbir Me Aelaane wafa Hai
yeh Mit Nahi Sakta Hai Yeh Zehra Ki Dua Mai
1. Zehra Ke Gulistaa'n Ko Loota Gaya Ban Me
pamaal Huva Qasim-e-naushah Bhi Ran Me aur Qaima-e-shabbir Me Kohraam Bapa Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zainab Ne Kaha Peet Ke Sar Haye Re Ghurbath
ab Koun Karega Meri Chadar Ki Hifazath
darya Pe Alamdar-e-jari Qatl Huva Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Farmati Thi Rokar Yehi Bas Zainab-e-nashaad
kis Tarha Badhau'n Mai Qadam Sayyad-e-sajjad
har Simt Tamashayi Hai Sar Mera Khula Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Q1smath Se Mila Jo Hamein Shabbir Ka Hai Gham
yeh Jeete Ji Hoga Na Kabhi Zindagi Me Kam
har Lamha Hamein Fatima Zehra Ki Dua Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kin Ankhou'n Se Shashmahe Ko Dekhegi Woh Mad
marjaye Na Sadme Se Kahin Bano-e-muztar
nanha Sa Gal Zulm Ke Nawak Se Chida Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jakda Huva Zanjeerou'n Me Hai Abid-e-muztar
kis Tarha Se Dafnaye Bhala Lasha-e-khwahar
ek Bhai Pe Zinda'n Me Ajab Waqt Pada Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Jo Ran Me Luti Hai Usi Jaageer Ka Matam
karte Raho Har Haal Me Shabbir Ka Matam
majlis Yeh Najaf Hazrat-e-zainab Ki Ataa Hai
